meta.name: get-unpublished-changes
meta.description: Compare HEAD with the latest published npm versions and list all unpublished changes by release layer. Triggers: unpublished changes, changelog, what changed, whats new.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 列出尚未发布的 npm 改动,按发布层级分组。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把本地改动与已发布版本对比,发布前心中有数。
copy.tagline_en: See what changed since the last published npm release.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to review unpublished changes before releasing.

howto.what: 装上后,当话题涉及 npm 包未发布的改动时,它会自动对比当前代码(HEAD)与最新已发布版本,读取真实代码差异而不是提交信息,按 pure components、opencode、codex 三层归类,并给出各层级的版本号建议。
howto.when: 当你提到“unpublished changes”“changelog”“what changed”等关键词,或询问更新日志时,它就会开始比对当前代码与最新已发布版本。

say.text: 看看 oh-my-opencode 有哪些未发布的改动
say.note: 会直接开始比对并给出分层结果。

say.text: 帮我生成一份未发布改动的 changelog,按层级分类
say.note: 会把差异按三个发布层整理成清单。

say.text: 比较当前代码和已发布版本,建议一下版本号
say.note: 会给出各层级及整体的版本号建议。

howto.what_en: It compares current code (HEAD) with latest published npm versions, reads real diffs instead of commit messages, groups changes by release layer (pure components, opencode, codex), and recommends version bumps per layer.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention 'unpublished changes', 'changelog', 'what changed', 'whats new', or ask about changelog / unreleased changes.

say_en.note: Starts the diff and shows layered results.

say_en.text: Generate a changelog of unpublished changes grouped by layer.
say_en.note: Arranges the diffs into the three release layers.

say_en.text: Compare current code with the published version and suggest version numbers.
say_en.note: Gives version recommendations per layer and overall.
